A spectral mask fashioned from the skull of an Eternal Guardian. Equips in the Mask curio slot, providing §a+4 Armor§r and preventing §3Endermen§r from angering when looked at.

§6Attunement & Spectral Gaze§r
Grants the §6Spectral Gaze§r ability to detect entities through walls. Wearing the mask gradually attunes it over 6 hours of continuous use, expanding its range and clarity:
• §6Stage I (0-3h):§r 16-block radius (white glow)
• §6Stage II (3-4.5h):§r 32-block radius
• §6Stage III (4.5-6h):§r 48-block radius
• §6Stage IV (6h+):§r 64-block radius with chromatic outlines: §cRed§r (hostile), §eYellow§r (neutral), §aGreen§r (passive), §bAqua§r (aquatic), and §fWhite§r (players & villagers).
Crafted by fastening Leather straps to both sides of an §5Eternal Guardian Head§r.
